title: John Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo's a top-tier back and he's planning to play that way

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh: Cam Skattebo's a top-tier back and he's planning to play that way
sources.description: The Giants were seen as a potential landing spot for running back Jeremiyah Love in the first round of this year's draft, but they never had a chance to consider him while on the clock because Arizona made Love the third overall choice.
